name: Brigade Avalon
description: A low-density project of 206 apartments in three towers on Whitefield Main Road, with about 80% of the site kept as open space. Homes are 3.5 and 4 BHK layouts, served by a 25,000 sq.ft clubhouse.
curation: Only 206 homes across three towers of 15 floors
About 80% of the land left as open space
Walkable to Nexus Mall and a Manipal hospital on Varthur Road
developerNote: Founded in 1986, Brigade Group is a publicly listed company on the NSE and BSE. Its portfolio spans residential, commercial, retail, and hospitality developments, from apartments and integrated enclaves to offices, malls, hotels, and schools.
photoDescription: Residential towers above a landscaped drive
